`215-215`: ** Major** · **Stability & Availability** · **Heavy lift** **Unverified finding** Verification ran but could not confirm this finding. It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Allow an admitted read to reach its fresh-client attempt.** After a Redis restart, requests A and B can hold two dead pooled connections. A fails first and starts a fresh GET. While A waits for its reply, B fails on its original connection and opens the breaker. Line 215 then rejects B with `RedisUnavailableException` before B can try a fresh client. A can subsequently succeed against healthy Redis. This leaves concurrent session reads failing even when fresh connections work. Coordinate retry admission with breaker accounting so each admitted read can make its single fresh-client attempt. Keep unrelated calls subject to fail-fast admission, and keep writes non-replayed.
